title: Cluster version label switches to `vMajor.Minor.Patch` in 3.4 — cluster generators on the old form match nothing

detection.reason: the agent projects every value an ApplicationSet's cluster generators select on the argocd.argoproj.io/kubernetes-version label (matrix/merge nesting included); a bare Major.Minor value is the pre-change form. Evaluated only when the gate finds a cluster Secret carrying auto-label-cluster-info — the condition upstream states

gate.reason: upstream conditions the breakage on cluster Secrets that carry argocd.argoproj.io/auto-label-cluster-info — only those have their kubernetes-version label rewritten to vMajor.Minor.Patch; a label you maintain by hand keeps matching

quote: Application Sets with Cluster Generators, that fetch clusters based on their Kubernetes version and use `argocd.argoproj.io/auto-label-cluster-info` on the cluster secret, need to be updated to use `argocd.argoproj.io/kubernetes-version` with the `vMajor.Minor.Patch` format instead of the previous `Major.Minor` format.
remediation: These ApplicationSets select on the old `Major.Minor` form and at least one cluster Secret carries `argocd.argoproj.io/auto-label-cluster-info`, so the label they match is rewritten to `vMajor.Minor.Patch` at this version: change the selector values (for example `v1.32.13` instead of `1.32`) before upgrading. The breakage is SILENT: the generator matches no cluster and its Applications disappear without an error or an event.
verifyCommand: kubectl get applicationsets -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.. | ."argocd.argoproj.io/kubernetes-version"? // empty | tostring] | map(test("^v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$") | not) | any) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # names printed still select on the old Major.Minor format, which matches no cluster after the change

title: Application health reads `Missing` only when every resource is missing

detection.reason: which automation reads Application health to detect missing resources is outside the cluster

quote: Applications now show `Missing` health **only when ALL resources are missing** (e.g., before the first sync)
remediation: Point automation that used `Missing` health to detect absent resources at the `OutOfSync` sync status instead, and inspect individual resource health where needed.

title: gRPC service-config DNS TXT lookups are disabled by default

detection.reason: whether you serve gRPC service config over DNS TXT records is a DNS fact, not inventory

quote: The environment variable `GRPC_ENABLE_TXT_SERVICE_CONFIG` is now set to `false` by default for all ArgoCD components
remediation: Only if you rely on `_grpc_config.<hostname>` TXT records: set `controller.grpc.enable.txt.service.config: "true"` in argocd-cmd-params-cm. Everyone else gains fewer DNS queries in dual-stack clusters.

title: Bundled Dex 2.45: gomplate preprocessing and `ContinueOnConnectorFailure` on by default

detection.reason: the Dex configuration is the VALUE of argocd-cm's `dex.config` key; ConfigMap values are not collected

quote: Gomplate is used internally, but users that have configured Dex for preprocessing may be impacted.
remediation: If `dex.config` uses templated preprocessing, re-test it against gomplate; set `dexserver.connector.failure.continue: "false"` in argocd-cmd-params-cm if a failing connector must still stop Dex.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get cm argocd-cm -o jsonpath='{.data.dex\.config}' | grep -E 'type:' # connectors printed are what Dex 2.45 loads; check any templated preprocessing

title: go-oidc 3.17: an expired token signed by a rotated key no longer redirects to SSO

detection.reason: the identity provider's key-rotation grace period is not something the cluster records; the hint names argocd-cm when OIDC is configured

quote: For a token that is both **expired** and **signed by a key that has since removed from JWKS due to rotation**, the signature verification failure will not redirect the user to SSO. Instead the user would be redirected to the login page and would need to manually initiate the SSO login.
remediation: Ask the identity provider to keep serving rotated keys in its JWKS for longer than the token lifetime; otherwise users with stale sessions land on the login page instead of being re-authenticated.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get cm argocd-cm -o jsonpath='{.data.oidc\.config}' | grep -E 'issuer' # the issuer printed must serve rotated keys for a grace period longer than the token lifetime

title: OpenTelemetry 1.42 / semantic conventions 1.40: metric names and attributes change

detection.reason: Grafana dashboards and alerts built on Argo CD's OTel metrics are not on the cluster

quote: Please see semantic conventions release notes for a list of changed metric names and dropped attributes, which may require changes in your Argo CD Grafana dashboards/alerts based on OTEL.
remediation: Review dashboards and alerts that query Argo CD's OTel-exported metrics against the semantic-conventions 1.40 rename list before upgrading.
